description: Merkle membership proof verifier ignores sibling side bit when combining hashes, failing inclusion proofs on right-hand leaves.
spec_notes: MerkleProofVerifier.verify must concatenate left and right hashes according to is_sibling_right direction.

repo_files.proof.py:
"""Merkle tree membership proof."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import List, Tuple


@dataclass
class MembershipProof:
    leaf_data: str
    leaf_index: int
    # Each step is (sibling_hash, is_sibling_right)
    audit_path: List[Tuple[str, bool]]

tests.test_merkle_proof.py:
from merkle_tree import MerkleTree
from verifier import MerkleProofVerifier
from proof import MembershipProof


def test_valid_inclusion_proof_for_all_leaves():
    leaves = ["leaf_0", "leaf_1", "leaf_2", "leaf_3", "leaf_4"]
    tree = MerkleTree(leaves)
    root = tree.root
    for i in range(len(leaves)):
        proof = tree.generate_proof(i)
        assert MerkleProofVerifier.verify(proof, root) is True


def test_tampered_leaf_data_rejected():
    leaves = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
    tree = MerkleTree(leaves)
    proof = tree.generate_proof(1)
    tampered = MembershipProof("tampered_data", proof.leaf_index, proof.audit_path)
    assert MerkleProofVerifier.verify(tampered, tree.root) is False


def test_wrong_root_rejected():
    tree = MerkleTree(["a", "b"])
    proof = tree.generate_proof(0)
    assert MerkleProofVerifier.verify(proof, "00" * 32) is False
